summary.headline: Windows 10 feature update guidance links to the central policy workflow
summary.summary: The guidance for devices ineligible for Windows 11 now points administrators to the central feature update policy workflow for policy behavior, creation, and licensing requirements.
summary.adminImpact: When targeting Windows 11, retain the fallback option for ineligible devices and confirm the tenant meets feature-update licensing requirements.

summary.headline: Mobile Threat Defense adds certificate synchronization information
summary.summary: Mobile Threat Defense connector guidance was expanded with certificate synchronization content and refreshed connector-status material.
summary.adminImpact: Review certificate inventory sharing with each MTD partner before enabling the connector capability.

summary.headline: Certificate synchronization follows device check-in cadence
summary.summary: The connector setup guidance states that Certificate Sync data is sent to Mobile Threat Defense partners at an interval based on device check-in.
summary.adminImpact: Factor device check-in frequency into expectations for when certificate inventory reaches the MTD partner.

summary.headline: Hotpatch management guidance introduced
summary.summary: A new article explains Hotpatch updates and managing them through Windows quality update policies in Intune.
summary.adminImpact: Use quality update policies to evaluate and plan Hotpatch deployment for eligible Windows devices.

summary.headline: Windows quality update policy guidance introduced
summary.summary: A new quality update policy article describes Hotpatch security updates that take effect without a restart.
summary.adminImpact: Assess Hotpatch eligibility and restart expectations when building a quality update servicing plan.
